# A 0.00 USD invoice, "overpaid" with 100.00 USD converted into 137.00 CAD.
#
# An overpayment is valued at the rate the payment converted at — what the
# bank received over everything it paid for — and the question this answers is
# whether that division can ever have nothing to divide by. It would take
# every split the payment puts on the receivable to be zero, the excess
# included, and the excess is the overpayment itself.
#
# What this fixture produces: the invoice is refused, and not by that
# arithmetic. A 0.00 USD posting has no rate in it — no value to divide by an
# amount — so the invoice carries no cost to measure a realized difference
# against, and the settlement returns before the overpayment is valued. That
# return is silent when the payment block carries no split lines; this one
# carries `Income:FX Gain $residual$`, which nothing would then place, so the
# message names that line and says where to write it instead.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_payment_exchange_rate.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-US"
	name: "US Customer"
	currency: USD

invoice "INV-USD-ZERO"
	customer_id: "C-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 0
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD-ZERO"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 100
		account: "Assets:Bank"
		settled_amount: 137.00
		prepayment: 100
		memo: "Payment for INV-USD-ZERO"
		Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
